title: From kubectl to a running container

questions.prompt: kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx: what happens, in order?
items: kubectl sends the request to the API server
The API server stores the desired state in etcd
The Deployment controller creates a ReplicaSet
The ReplicaSet controller creates Pod objects
The scheduler assigns each Pod to a node
The kubelet pulls the image and starts the container
questions.explanation: This chain, from desired state to running container, is the heart of Kubernetes.
